newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Mediolanum '96 net profit up 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Mediolanum '96 net profit up 11 pct.

text.p: Italian insurance and financial services group Mediolanum SpA said it posted 1996 net profit of 104.2 billion lire, up 11 percent on 1995, on total group revenues of 1.25 trillion lire, up 23 percent.
The company, jointly owned by Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest group and Mediolanum managing director Ennio Doris, said in a statement it proposed paying a 1996 dividend of 360 lire per share.
Mediolanum was listed on the Milan bourse in June 1996.
It said in a statement that 1996 group return on equity was 19.4 percent. Life insurance premium income accounted for 1.19 trillion lire of total revenues.
Total managed assets at end-1996 amounted to 11.76 trillion lire against 10.66 trillion at end-1995.
Mediolanum shares closed in Milan on Wednesday up 0.14 percent at 14,738 lire.
